concept.title: AI optimization
concept.shortdesc: DITA contains consistent tagging, metadata, and reusable components that align naturally with modern AI architectures

conbody.p: DITA contains consistent tagging, metadata, and reusable components that align naturally with modern AI architectures such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). This allows writers to achieve seamless integration with AI pipelines, train models, automate responses, and support intelligent documentation systems, and improve the retrieval accuracy of their AI models.
